sections.text_en: The delivered policy is the unchanged starting frozen profile, selected by the predeclared validity-first order. Its original hard judgments were technically valid with zero raw wrong allows across the original repeats. Both fully compared descendants failed a higher-priority original hard condition and had lower personal-reference agreement. The historical milestone remains separate from this fresh round.

The experiments clarified finite template-name and cookie exceptions, real action destinations, explicit settings and semantic coverage. Separate presentation trials tested original-order reading without adding source characters. Each variant was frozen before inference. Failed variants, the variant withdrawn before inference, and incomplete original groups remain visible. Deduplication algorithms and keeper selection were not changed.

The direction and pair targets were not reached in the original complete groups. A descendant single-run stage result was saved as provisional and explicitly not confirmed by its original group mean. The retained policy still has original hard false blocks, invalid judgments in the full datasets, and failed independently fixed supplemental controls. Cookie-setting controls contain main and final wrong allows; an equivalent-state control also contains an invalid response. All fixed denominators and failed original run identities remain intact.

Only checks actually executed during this task are counted. The selected policy reuses its actual same-task implementation checks because its prompt files, native code and test sources are unchanged. Supplemental controls retain their original declared repetitions and separate per-layer tables. Implementation-test passes do not establish policy acceptance.

sections.title_en: Independent offline reproduction and archival receipt
sections.text_en: The source commit includes an offline replay entry. It redirects recorded checksum locations to independently restored data, rejects reads from original data and source checkouts, and blocks network connections. Frozen records and native scoring code remain unchanged. Final archive extraction, source restoration and exact replay are recorded after this source commit in archive-and-restore-receipt.json; only that actual receipt establishes archival success.
